sentences: Hi Mike, this is Yara from GPS Tronic in Brazil.
The part number is A, G, four, four, oh, seven, two.
The unit price is eighty-nine dollars and ninety cents.
The total is two hundred and fifteen dollars with shipping.
The delivery takes about ten business days.
We can ship it on October third.
I will reply with the tracking number when it ships.

grammar.title: Falando códigos, preços em dólar e datas sem errar
rules: Código de peça se fala letra por letra e dígito por dígito (zero vira "oh"): AG-44072 → "A, G, four, four, oh, seven, two".
Preço em dólar: "eighty-nine dollars and ninety cents" ($89.90). Hundred e thousand nunca levam -s após número ("two hundred dollars").
Atenção à escrita: em inglês a vírgula separa o milhar e o ponto separa os centavos ($1,250.50).
Datas usam números ordinais: October first (Oct 1), October second (Oct 2), October third (Oct 3).
